items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I says, I've got a job to go away. You want to? Yeah, yeah. ... Johnny duck and duck ... I'll take it and brought it. When I brought him, Johnny takes in glad. He was the first one at the train. ... Johnny was in Chicago. And Johnny never had come back here.

ctx.x: I never did know much about the figure Johnny.
He used to walk around the district every time you see a corner player missing. Johnny's dead in the district with his corner, walking around. Nobody was playing, nobody regular. You know?
Always looking for a job, hoping to get a job.
